limitations: Contended shared-lease build times, not dedicated compiler throughput.

linearCacheProjection.scope: Illustrative linear extrapolation of eight early unit0 crates only; not a measured full-world bound. Excludes baseline linked artifacts, source/top-level/runtime/dependency caches and uneven crate sizes. Retained old-session query cache raises after-edit bytes.

nativeScope: Original Unit fixture executed and every event/selected state matched across builds. Eight genuine generated part crates were compiled unchanged but their whole program initialization/battles were not executed; this is build-reuse evidence, not new battle qualification.
